Container.Name: unraid-dashboard-helper
Container.Overview: Beacon update helper — the optional second half of Beacon. It is the ONLY component with Docker-socket access and performs strict, verified dashboard updates: registry digest match, full config preservation, health checks and automatic rollback. It serves 127.0.0.1:8790 only (token-authenticated, fail-closed without a token) and has no web UI — it is managed from Beacon's Settings → Updates. Note: the helper listens on localhost only, so a bridge-network dashboard cannot reach it; pair it with the compose bundle (recommended, docs/INSTALL.md) or a host-network dashboard.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Container Path: /var/run/docker.sock — the helper is the only Beacon component with Docker access

Config.Name: Helper state
Config.Description: Container Path: /helper-state — persistent update snapshots and job state (required for proven rollback)

Config.Name: Update helper token
Config.Description: Container Variable: UPDATE_HELPER_TOKEN — shared secret (min 32 chars, openssl rand -hex 32); set the SAME value in the dashboard container. Fail-closed without it.

Config.Name: Dashboard port
Config.Description: Container Variable: DASHBOARD_PORT — port of the dashboard container on the host

Config.Name: Target container
Config.Description: Container Variable: TARGET_CONTAINER — the only container this helper may update
